comment: Auto-generated skip_codegen patches for perl 5.26. Functions whose generated body fails to type-check on this perl version (often due to macro expansion differences vs newer perl). Re-run tools/build-error-to-vpatches.pl after each perl-headers update or libperl-macrogen change.

patches.name: Perl_is_utf8_string
patches.reason: Old-style utf8 validity-check inline (5.26 utf8.h, before the 5.28 UTF-8 machinery rework) expands to bool/int-mixed condition chains that the codegen's bool coercion does not fully cover (E0308). Same residual class as the v5.32/v5.34 residual entries; candidate for a future codegen fix. Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 re-evaluation (build-error.log in tmp/multi-perl/out/). Note: S_is_utf8_fixed_width_buf_loclen_flags / isUTF8_CHAR_flags DO compile on 5.26 and were un-skipped in the same round.

patches.name: RX_ENGINE
patches.reason: struct regexp's `engine` field is `const struct regexp_engine *` (regexp.h), so the generated body `(*ReANY(prog)).engine` yields *const regexp_engine while the inferred return type is *mut regexp_engine (E0308). Const propagation from struct-field reads is a future codegen fix; the name is not in the 5.26 apidoc dict so a return_type_override cannot patch it. Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 re-evaluation.

patches.name: RX_MATCH_UTF8_off
patches.reason: Expands to `RXp_EXTFLAGS(ReANY(prog)) |= / &= flag` where RXp_EXTFLAGS is itself generated as a helper fn, so the compound assignment gets a function call on the left-hand side (E0067 invalid left-hand side of assignment). Write-through accessor support would be a new codegen feature (Signature Approval). Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 re-evaluation.

patches.name: S_perl_hash_one_at_a_time_hard
patches.reason: Internal hash-function inline (hv_func.h) removed/reworked in modern perl. The old implementations use loop macros that reassign their induction variable (E0384 MURMUR_DOBYTES), u8/u32 mixed arithmetic (E0277) and assignment-position casts (E0067) that the codegen does not support. S_-prefixed internal implementation, not public API. Verified failing in the 2026-08-29 re-evaluation.

patches.name: sv_collxfrm
patches.reason: Upstream sv.h bug on this version: `#define sv_collxfrm(sv, nxp) sv_cmp_flags(sv, nxp, SV_GMAGIC)` calls sv_cmp_flags instead of sv_collxfrm_flags, passing STRLEN* where SV* is expected (E0308). Latent in C because core code never calls the short name. Still present in 5.32 headers (see v5.32.patches.json), fixed upstream by 5.34.

patches.name: RCPV_LEN
patches.reason: RCPV_* does not exist before perl 5.38 (cop.h RCPV refactor), so the common return_type_override has no target here and only emits a MISS warning (dict lookup fails; issue #17). Cancel the common patch on this version.
